description: The pinned FrostEngine corpora of the -Corpus verify tier (ADR 0077 decision 7, ADR 0078; PLAN.md section 7, Roadmap v2). tools/corpora.py fetch makes each one a full `git clone --no-hardlinks` of 'url' (or, only when that fails, of a local path given with --fallback-source) checked out detached at 'sha', in <root>/<id>-<sha[:12]>; <root> is $FROST_CORPORA_ROOT, else E:\FrostBuilds\corpora on Windows and ~/FrostBuilds/corpora (ext4) on Linux. tools/corpora.py pin re-resolves 'sha' from the tip of 'branch' with git ls-remote. The tests and the verify scripts never read a developer's live engine tree, only these clones. 'presets' names the configure preset each platform's corpus tests use.

corpora.name: FrostEngine
corpora.purpose: R0 exit (FND-9a): opening the engine folder records no GUI stall above 250 ms, starts exactly one clangd and negotiates positionEncodings; later the R1/R2 journeys (j1_cmake) and FEC-10a's generated Lua API.
